decisions.reason: The online ordering and digital services platform still fits the firm's strategic shift toward service-intensive, complex projects, and because it likely remains relatively inexpensive to maintain while generating learning and cross-selling value, we keep this option open.

The fire and smoke protection door sits close to the firm's core safety and compliance capabilities, so even with only modest market visibility the cost of retaining it appears low enough to justify keeping it on the market while demand evidence continues to build.
